integrity: An explicit CRT base cycle and an odd-prime lifting lemma provide an infinite proof. A separate exact-integer program checks the family for 137 finite moduli, including the closing edge; the computational sample is not used as an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: The construction covers exactly the asserted family with two distinct prime divisors 3 and p>=5; it neither proves the all-odd-moduli conjecture nor establishes priority against inaccessible or unindexed literature. Finite computations supplement a complete algebraic proof.
title: Cyclic unit-difference permutations for moduli with prime support \(\{3,p\}\)
